Name: TourDesk
Company description: TourDesk is a comprehensive tour-booking service for resellers. It brings a new source of revenue, increases your service level, and reduces the workload on your front desk and back office. Bringing ancillary revenue for hotels and other resellers goes hand in hand with providing guests a better service, as the resellers can offer them relevant tours and activities. TourDesk offers two main features:  • The Agent System, used by the front desk staff as a point-of-sale. The Agent System allows the front desk and/or concierge to easily and securely identify, book, and confirm a tour for a guest standing in front of them.  • The Sales Portal, used by guests to plan their adventures. TourDesk creates a customised Sales Portal that you can share with your guests so they can book on their own. For suppliers, TourDesk offers increased visibility and simplified accounting. TourDesk also offers easy connectivity and connects directly to most major booking systems in the world. No booking system? No problem - TourDesk supports all types of suppliers. TourDesk has a vested interest in increasing your revenue!
